interpretation: All 12 node snapshots matched final head. Measured archive read/reuse counters prove this workload used the verified archive material reuse path; they do not prove its isolated TPS contribution.
Per node first CPU records reads_started=1, verified_material_reused=2, io_recover.calls=1; GPU and CPU-repeat each record 2/4/2. Counts of archive starts and io_recover agree in these snapshots.

Every node in all three rounds records strict_verified_rows=4096 and reused_rows=4096, uca_batch_calls=4. These count local successful verification and consumed proof rows, not 8192 distinct transactions per node.
Successor promotion and early body enqueue obligations are recorded separately. Logical bytes/obligations are not actual wire traffic, retransmission counts or delivery completion.
Phase wall totals can include nested/overlapping work. No timings are subtracted from TPS and no counter-to-latency causal conclusion is made.
These are diagnostic 4K samples, not 65K acceptance or an explanation of every prior long-tail event.

measurement_limits: All eight rounds report pass, cold recovery and full fees, zero transport failures/business failures/nonce rejection/deadline expiry. This is measured local load correctness, not full release acceptance.
65K rounds have 64 blocks of 1024 rows, maximum 8192 in flight, the original slowest-of-four receipt observation endpoint, and an uninterrupted denominator including post-submit signing/preparation.
4K static input excludes all signing/preparation before the first submission. Continuous 65K excludes only initial bounded preparation and includes later work. The two modes are separate evidence.
Headline TPS excludes startup; startup-through-four-receipts remains separately recorded, including GPU startup qualification. Neither is an internal durable finality timestamp.

The primary 4K/65K performance groups have diagnostics/progress disabled and final_local_progress=NOT_ENABLED. Their archive read/reuse counts and stage-gap causality are NOT_MEASURED, not zero. The separately appended diagnostic_4096 group records its own counters and is not substituted for those performance runs.

continuous_generator_starved_poll_us covers measured SDK poll wall while no prepared tail is available, not isolated signer time. Generation, polling and prepare times overlap and are not added or subtracted from TPS.

Current combined continuous 65K genesis/corpus differs from prior archive-only continuous 65K groups. Cross-group TPS differences are not a strict isolated patch-effect experiment. Strict same-input before/after evidence is separately recorded for both the 4K and static 65K groups.
Retain the 4K CPU negative, earlier F286 CPU negative and prior 17.325802-second P99 sample. These passing runs do not prove those slow-round causes closed.
65K remains approximately 2.5K to 2.8K TPS, far below historical approximately 12K. Functional tests, graph wiring and bounded-work progress proof are not performance completion.
One Windows host, four independent processes; no Linux or four-physical-machine result, no production deployment and no main promotion.
